resolved_sign_recipe.paper_section: Data exploration paragraph immediately before Figure5: hip/knee extension positive, ankle plantarflexion positive.
resolved_sign_recipe.inference: Combining explicit plot convention and code establishes segmented source hipflexionpositive/kneeextensionpositive/ankledorsiflexionpositive, for both angle and moment. Canonical flexion/DF sign recipe is +hip,-knee,+ankle. This resolves why matching paper plots does not require copying their signs.
resolved_sign_recipe.limits: Code reads segmented average MAT structs, not raw CSV. Units in figures Nm/kg differ from documented raw Nm. Do not import plot normalization into raw data.

source_velocity_discrepancy.README_claim: First-order backward finite difference of angle
source_velocity_discrepancy.paper_claim: Filtered IK, central finite differences via MATLAB gradient
source_velocity_discrepancy.distinction: Imported raw velocity is a source measurement product and may be preserved byte/value-faithfully with unknown preprocessing. Contradictory differentiation descriptions block claiming a verified recomputation recipe, not preservation of supplied values.
source_velocity_discrepancy.no_invented_fix: Do not replace velocities or select difference method to match a desired waveform.

publisher_vs_local_segments.generator_clock: Fixeddt1/200 for gradient; sourceHeaderis copied but nonuniformness not verified
publisher_vs_local_segments.critical_limit: YZX components and pelvis+pi/2 offsets are local processing conventions, not authoritative publisher anatomical definitions.

model_evidence.Statics_trial_association: ball_toss_1 and sit_to_stand_1 select static1; publisher original model is linked by byte hash, not filename inference
model_evidence.axis_known: Both hip/knee source custom joints use +Z rotation coefficient+1; ankle axes mirroredX/Y with commonpositiveZ. This describes model coordinates, not proof all CSV exports retain them.
model_evidence.next_bounded_native_proof: On publisher-matched AB01 static1 only: neutral and ±smallcoordinate perturbations, derive proximal/distal station changes to establish flexion/DF and generalized-force work conjugacy; serialize modelSHA/stationdefinition/coordinateclock. Schedule separately, no native work run.

next_bounded_raw_proof.scope: Extend independent raw-source readback in NEW revision to six angles and six supplied velocities across bothphysical sides, sourceclock/window/rowidentity/fulloutput/missingness and documenteddeg→rad. Existingforce/momentaudit does not prove these fields.
next_bounded_raw_proof.methods: Direct literalrawCSV projected bounded batches; compare converter outputs to independent interpolated source samples, reversing only explicitproducer sign. Separate source-preservation pass from anatomical approval.
next_bounded_raw_proof.raw_to_segment: Use one author parsing interval and per-cycle segmented MAT values where format/recipe is documented; verify sourcecoordinate correspondence including sign, not waveform appearance. If only averages or unknown interpolation available, retain link as unresolved.

non_sagittal_fields: Hip adduction/rotation and subtalar source coordinates require separate axes/sign evidence; sagittal plotting proof does not cover them.
completion_rule: Source aliases/nulls are interim safe representation, not scientific completion. Full anatomy approval requires actual perfeature source and model proof plus bounded independent readback.
